title: Ambient normalized primitive comparison data exist simultaneously on all schemes
statement: For every prime ell there is one family of whole-system reduction/realization calculi, natural Roos models, normalized primitive pullback and scalar realization models, indexed by every finite ell-adic coefficient field, every embedding and every scheme. The actual completion unit is invertible on constructible inputs; the scalar whole-system counit is invertible on such inputs; pullback counits are invertible when ell is invertible on source and target. No geometric or scalar coherence equation is asserted. These are exactly the fields of IntegralComparisonSystem in the Lean attachment.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 0941; Strict quotient model construction and descent; extension of the primitive-model scope beyond the invertible-base indexing of EffectiveComparisonRealizationModels.

proof.text: Choose the existing evaluation calculus for each field and scheme. Its fixed-calculus ordinary and derived completion models construct the K-injective-normalized Roos model via the existing roosModel construction. No ell-invertibility is needed.

For each scheme map, take fixed-calculus models on the source of the reduction. The ordinary quotient pullback tower comparison, followed by the fixed target Roos comparison, is an isomorphism on good complexes. Descend along the existing pullback universal localization. Whole-system adjunction coherence supplies a strict comparison with every tested presentation; naturality and cancellation give its generator and entire derived normalization equations.
For scalar extension use the single-scheme ambient coherent scalar realization theorem for the same chosen source calculus and target Roos model. This supplies only primitive scalar models.

The existing transported pullback normalization gives normalized pullback reductions on ell-invertible schemes. For scalar extension, repeat the existing scalar normalization argument without its unused ell-invertibility hypothesis: finite balanced association and the strict representative normalization field transport through the unique universal comparison with the specified sequence scalar functor. Apply unrestricted normalized reconstruction to obtain the actual system counits. The model realization maps are isomorphisms, so their reductions followed by those counits are isomorphisms.

Convert intrinsic derived completeness to the existing unrestricted completeness using an auxiliary finite field of characteristic p greater than ell. Unrestricted reconstruction gives the actual unit isomorphism on each constructible input. Assemble coefficient and scalar records with classical simultaneous choice.
